d.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six® Vegas
d.desc: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six makes its next-generation hardware debut in the most dramatic installment of the renowned first-person shooter franchise to date. Rainbow operatives take to the chaotic streets of Las Vegas as an escalating terrorist siege in 'Sin City' threatens to take world terrorism to new, uncontrollable heights.
min: Originally released for Windows 7, the game can be played on Windows 10 and Windows 11 OS
3 GHz Pentium 4 or AMD Athlon 3000 (3.5 GHz Pentium 4 or Athlon 3500 recommended)
128 MB DirectX 9.0c-compliant, Shader 3.0-enabled video card (256MB recommended) (see supported list*)
DirectX 9-compliant sound card (PC audio solution containing Dolby Digital Live required for Dolby Digital audio)
d.blurb:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Vegas is a tactical first-person shooter. Rainbow operatives respond to a terrorist attack on Las Vegas, fighting through the streets and casinos of Sin City.

You lead a two-man team, using a cover system that lets you switch between first and third person, rappelling and planning breaches. Commanding your squad is key to success. It suits fans of tactical shooters looking for a classic.
